adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, deleteEvent now computes `calendarId` as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When `externalCalendarId` is not provided (undefined/null), the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined`), which will not match normal destination calendars, so `calendarId` becomes undefined. This breaks selecting the correct calendar for deletion and can cause the Google delete request to target an invalid/incorrect calendar (or rely on fallback behavior), potentially leaving the original event undeleted (orphaned).
